summary: Iteration 4 (v1.3) — Backend pytest 64/64 PASSED (54 baseline + 10 new v1.3). Frontend Playwright verified all 4 new v1.3 features: (1) RFP scoring matrix — rfp-scoring-matrix with criterion rows, score inputs, auto-computed weighted total (verified 80/70 -> 76.00 matches server 60*.8+40*.7), save-score-{bidId} hits POST /api/bids/{id}/score and toast shows 'Weighted total: 76', TOP badge on best bid; (2) RFQ line-item matrix — rfq-matrix with per-cell matrix-{row}-{bidId}, LOW badge on lowest unit price per row, LOWEST on totals footer, per-vendor Award button; (3) Category mode toggle — catmode-kz/catmode-general present, RFP defaults to 'general' (Consulting & Advisory list of 19 options), toggling flips dropdown between KZ industry (Land survey / Medical gas etc.) and General; (4) shadcn DateTimePicker replaces native datetime-local — ct-deadline is a BUTTON that opens Popover with Calendar + ct-deadline-time input; submit without deadline shows toast 'Please pick a submission deadline.'; also verified TenderList tender-filter-category contains both KZ + General items (200 options total). All prior baseline flows (auth, vendor, tender/RFP/RFQ create, bid create, award) unaffected.

minor.issue: Server clamps individual scores to [0,100] before computing weighted total (verified: score 150 -> total 60.0 = 60*1.0). This is correct behavior but silent — consider warning or rejecting out-of-range scores with 400 for clearer UX.

Weight validation only triggers when evaluation_criteria is non-empty. An RFP created with empty evaluation_criteria bypasses the sum-to-100 check (which is technically correct, but downstream RfpScoringMatrix.jsx line 620 shows 'no criteria defined — please add them before scoring'). Consider requiring >=1 criterion for RFP at server-side.

issues: The Calendar's disabled-day styling is fine but the 'Done' button label lacks a data-testid. Not blocking — popover closes via click outside as well.
Total row uses bg-primary + white text for LOWEST — good high-contrast. LOW badge uses ml-2 text-[10px] tracking-widest — very subtle, could be more visible.
TOP badge is only shown after a save (uses server-persisted rfp_weighted_total, not draft). Draft edits render new totals but no TOP change until save — expected behavior but worth noting.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: (a) enforce >=1 evaluation_criteria on RFP create; (b) add data-testid to DateTimePicker 'Done' button; (c) make LOW/TOP badges visually stronger.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /bids/{id}/score is correct — validates ownership, RFP-only, clamps scores. Good.
server.py POST /tenders now validates evaluation_criteria weight sum == 100 (line 552-555). Server-side hardening from iter3 minor issue is complete.
TenderDetail.jsx RfpScoringMatrix.saveScore uses draftFor({id: bidId}) — small inefficiency, could just do drafts[bidId] || {}. Not a bug.
TenderDetail.jsx exceeds 700 lines (710) — same refactoring flag from iter3 stands. Split BidsComparison + FlatBidTable + RfqLineItemMatrix + RfpScoringMatrix into separate files.

DateTimePicker.jsx passing data-testid={testid}-cal to shadcn Calendar — but the day cells inside react-day-picker's grid don't auto-inherit that testid pattern (so scripted date-cell clicks require different selectors like 'button[name=day]'). Not a functional bug.
countries.js ALL_CATEGORY_FLAT concatenates without dedup — if a category name appears in both KZ and General lists, it would duplicate. Currently no overlap.

CreateTender.jsx submit() checks weight-sum client-side BEFORE checking submission_deadline — order is fine but the deadline check should also happen for tender & rfq (currently applies to all doc types since the field is required for all).
